Thymoma screening is prognostic/therapeutic, not diagnostic.

The clinical summary correctly identifies urgency for thymoma screening (given age and AChR+ status) and neurology evaluation, but the diagnosis itself is definitive based on serology + classic fatigable ocular motor signs. No other condition explains this triad: binocular diplopia + fatigable ptosis + positive AChR Ab.

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Myasthenia gravis
